title.en: If it sounds like a 90s tape in a Norwegian basement…
title.zh: 如果听起来像挪威地下室的 90 年代磁带……

summary.en: …then it is "true" black metal. Fidelity is suspicious; frostbite is authenticity.
summary.zh: ……那它就是「绝对纯正」的黑金。清晰度可疑；冻伤才是正统。

body.en:
Second-wave black metal lore treats bedroom/necro production as a purity test. Clean modern mixes get accused of selling out before anyone argues about riffs.

The joke is real in forums; the music still ranges from intentional lo-fi to later bands that can actually record. Listen past the ideology when you want songs, not visas.
body.zh:
第二波黑金传说把卧室 / necro 录音当纯度测试。现代干净混音还没吵到 riff，先被控堕落。

论坛里这梗是真的；音乐本身从故意 Lo-Fi 到后来会录音的乐队都有。想听歌而不是签证时，先把意识形态放一边。

note.en: Not BM—but thrash fans run a parallel "raw vs polished" fight.
note.zh: 不是黑金——但 thrash 粉有平行的「毛边 vs 抛光」内战。

note.en: Where "kvlt" production grades the tape hiss.
note.zh: 在那儿用磁带嘶声给「kvlt」打分。
